prompt:
I'm back in the Coderbyte IDE. Its AI agent can only create and edit files and I have to approve every edit, and it can't use your skills. Give me a prompt I can paste into it so it writes the edge case tests for slugifyFileName before I submit. The requirement is in TASK.md.

Input files: TASK.md, package.json, src/slugify.ts, src/slugify.test.ts
assertions: The response gives one paste-ready prompt in a code block that names slugifyFileName, src/slugify.ts and Vitest as the test framework
The pasted prompt tells the in-IDE assistant not to modify src/slugify.ts, and to report an expectation that disagrees with the code as a suspected bug instead of changing the expectation

The pasted prompt asks for an edge-case table with input, expected and why before writing tests, and names at least four concrete file-name cases such as an empty string, whitespace only, an uppercase extension, accented letters, multiple dots or a leading dot
src/slugify.ts is not modified during the run
